scope: current PSP source adapter against a fresh isolated upstream source build
psp_commit_note: origin/main at the start of the review; only compat documents, tests and the CI image pin follow this tested source commit.

upstream.build: upstream tagged source, `go build .` with the `internal/web/dist` stub the upstream Makefile also uses (placeholder SPA only)
upstream.xray_state_note: Xray 26.10.21 ships no darwin build, so the core could not start locally (fork/exec bin/xray-darwin-arm64: no such file or directory). No adapter test depends on the core; see limits.

environment.authentication: admin-scoped Bearer token (SHA-256 row inserted into api_tokens, the same table the panel CLI writes)
environment.panel_subscription_server: left at its defaults; PSP never calls it

ci_image_execution_method: No local container runtime was available. The manual Test workflow runs the pinned linux/amd64 image, which does carry a working xray binary, before merge.

notApplicable.reason: needs a fail2ban endpoint the 3X-UI image does not run; not part of the panel-backed surface

panel_reported_at_verification.note: getPanelUpdateInfo reaching GitHub from the panel and reporting current proves the route and the version field the compat gate reads.

supplementary.method: temporary in-package Go test file using the production adapter, deleted after the run
checks: SS-2022 aes-128-gcm inbound add accepted; chacha20-poly1305 still refused with 'does not support multiple users'; wrong-length server keys still refused with 'shadowsocks inbound password:' — both wordings unchanged from 3.10.2, so PSP's isPermanentPanelMsg still classifies them as domain.ErrValidation
PSP UpdateClient succeeds against the new KeepAliveValue type (keepAlive absent from PSP's payload)
A raw client update that omits clientHostRuleIds preserves the UUID and the stored binding, matching 3.11.0's documented omit-preserves merge rule
Disabling a client through PSP UpdateClient sticks

source_review.method: git diff v3.10.2..v3.11.0 on the official tagged source, per directory
findings: No route PSP calls was added, removed or renamed: /panel/api/inbounds/{add,del,get,list,list/slim,setEnable,update}, /panel/api/clients/{add,get,update,del,bulkAttach,bulkCreate,bulkDel,clientIpsByGuid}, /panel/api/server/* and /panel/api/xray/* all still exist with the same shapes
Two routes are ADDITIVE and unused by PSP: GET /clients/get/subId/:subId and GET /inbounds/amneziawgKernelReadiness

Token auth changed shape but not contract: api.go now resolves the scope before the mTLS branch and adds a node-admin scope. Admin tokens and the plain `Authorization: Bearer` header behave as before; node-admin only adds /server/updatePanel authority
New input validation covers XDRIVE inbounds, TUIC relay emails and AmneziaWG keepAlive ranges — PSP builds none of these protocols

Client model gained clientHostRuleIds (json array) and KeepAlive changed from *int to a KeepAliveValue type accepting integers or AmneziaWG ranges. Both marshal integers for non-AWG clients; PSP sends neither field

3.11.0 adds strict request-body schema validation on inbound add: a hand-built payload with a malformed settings string is rejected with 'request body failed validation'. PSP marshals settings with encoding/json, so this is a malformed-input improvement, not an incompatibility
Bundled Xray moves 26.10.10 -> 26.10.21, adding XDRIVE, Lua noise scripts, a finalmask source-IP filter and XDNS over DoH. PSP renders its own subscriptions and does not consume finalmask/XDNS

limits: The bundled Xray core could not run on darwin, so xrayState was 'error' throughout. This is adapter-surface evidence; the Linux container in CI covers a running core.
No historical PSP binary verification or existing-database upgrade verification.
No full proxy dataplane, live-connection continuity, multi-node production topology or full PSP traffic/reconcile-chain verification.
3X-UI native XDRIVE, AmneziaWG kernel datapath, TUIC relay, MTProto and per-client host binding are outside this PSP adapter certification.
